GUI_CONTAINER: On rendering the main game, this is a wrapper around the entire game UI
LAYER_FOREGROUND: The space foreground layer, includes the planet/solar flare/ion storm/nebula but not asteroids
LAYER_ASTEROIDS: The space asteroids layer, in front of the the space foreground
LAYER_PLAYER: The player ship, you can render things on top the player ship by using the after method of the callbacks
SHIP: Any active ship, you can render things on top the ship by using the after method of the callbacks
SHIP_MANAGER: `before_function` is equivalent to `roomAnim` layer 3, `after_function` is equivalent to `roomAnim` layer 4
SHIP_JUMP: Any active ship that is jumping, you can render things on top the ship by using the after method of the callbacks
SHIP_HULL: On rendering the ship hull, cloak and thruster animations
CREW_MEMBER_HEALTH: Runs for each `CrewMember` regardless of whether their health bar is visible
LAYER_FRONT: In front of player ship, where asteroids above the ship are rendered but you can draw whatever you want
FTL_BUTTON: Same layer as the FTL jump button and most of the player UI
SYSTEM_BOX: Called for each individual SystemBox, passed under the `systemBox` arg. Render coordinates are in the reference frame of the SystemBox. Unsure what `ignoreStatus` does.
SHIP_STATUS: On rendering player element like hull and ressources
CHOICE_BOX: When any choiceBox related window is on screen
TABBED_WINDOW: On rendering a tab in the upgrade interface
MOUSE_CONTROL: Rendering at the highest layer above everything else where the mouse cursor is finally drawn
